one_line: Flat-printed continuous-carbon ladder (fibre flanges + concentric rings round each window) on a home FibreSeeker 3, two segments bolted at z 290; passes rev C at beam level on assumed allowables but is HEAVIER than today (+61 g)
governing_case: fatigue: lumbar_tie fibre_c C_im3:static_carry|15; strength: lumbar_spine interlayer C_im3:side_hill_torsion|15; joint: sleeve ring fatigue (low bushing)
printer: FibreSeeker 3 home (CFC continuous carbon, dual nozzle; pre-sale 2026)
patents_checked: US 10,952,523 (Mystery Ranch, load lifters): crown, top bar and lifters unchanged; posts stay lash points
US 9,126,365 / US 9,579,851 / US 10,040,252 / US 9,156,205 (Markforged continuous-fibre printing process family): process claims on the machine; owner uses a commercial machine, no claim on the frame
docs/DECISIONS.md 2026-11-01 IP guardrail (extension posts lash/flag only)
governing_assumptions: ASSUMPTION ILSS 14 MPa dry (half the 28 MPa published for printed CF/PA6; published range 2.8-34) x 0.6 hot/wet -> coupon E-2
ASSUMPTION fibre-region strength = Markforged UD coupon (800 / 320 MPa, 60 GPa) x 0.85 part factor, x 0.8 hot/wet, x 0.65 impact on compression -> coupon E-1 (FibreSeek X-CCF has no datasheet)
ASSUMPTION fatigue: fibre FI <= 0.5, matrix / interlayer <= 0.3 at 1e5 x 1.6 g (no published endurance data for printed CCF; Pertuz 2020 short-life Basquin b = -0.039) -> coupon E-5 (1e5 cycles)
ASSUMPTION matrix (Onyx-class PA6-CF) 40 / 30 MPa XY / Z x 0.6 hot/wet; in-plane shear 20 MPa -> E-3
ASSUMPTION bolt bearing 60 MPa dry on a fibre-ringed M5 hole, no clamp-friction credit -> coupon E-4
ASSUMPTION sleeve ring: point-load ring moment, side-wall hoop across layers vs Z strength -> coupon E-6
ASSUMPTION beam model of frame.yaml is the load path (members re-sectioned, straight planar stays, lumbar grid kept as an open lattice); no voxel FE of junctions -> T1/T5 first article
ASSUMPTION interface features (pawl housing, hip boss, fairlead cheeks, clip lands, feet, corners, splice collars) 116 g Onyx allowance -> weigh first article
ASSUMPTION fibre lay rate 10 mm/s and matrix 8 mm3/s for print hours; FibreSeeker 3 ships as announced
coupon_tests: E-1 tension + compression (ASTM D3039 / D6641) of flat-printed X-CCF/PA-CF flange coupons, dry and conditioned 40 C / 85 % RH to saturation; >= 6 each; B-basis vs 544 / 166 MPa design
E-2 short-beam shear ASTM D2344, 0.125 mm layers, dry + conditioned; pass >= 14 MPa dry, >= 8.4 wet
E-3 in-plane shear (Iosipescu ASTM D5379) and matrix Z tension of the PA-CF matrix; >= 20 / 30 MPa
E-4 pin bearing ASTM D5961 on an M5 hole with 3 fibre rings, plus 1e5-cycle bearing fatigue at 0.3 x static
E-5 4-point-bend fatigue of a 400 mm stay section (flanges + bore) at the 1.6 g C1 moment x 1.0, R = 0.1, 1e5 cycles, then residual strength >= factored C2 moment
E-6 sleeve ring crush: 70 mm sleeve section, 18 mm UHMWPE bushing, diametral load to failure + 1e5 cycles at 1.6 g bushing force
E-7 fibre corner coupon: ring round a 10 mm radius stay-bar corner, T-pull to failure
First article: HA-LS-1 T1-T5 + T9 (load_standard.md) with the splice pencil-mark check
